title: Harrowgate Brewery weekly production status
brief: Hi, I manage production at Harrowgate Brewery and I need a status page for the week ending 2026-10-30, to print for the Monday production meeting. Headline numbers: 184000 liters brewed, a yield of 94.2 percent against a target of 95, packaging line efficiency of 78.4 percent against a target of 85, and 3 batches on quality hold. Under "Packaging efficiency trend" chart the weekly efficiency over eight weeks: W37 82.0, W38 81.5, W39 80.9, W40 80.2, W41 79.6, W42 79.1, W43 78.8, W44 78.4. Under "Packaging lines" give a table of output, efficiency and downtime hours: Canning, 412000 cans, 71.9 percent, 19.5 hours; Kegging, 3150 kegs, 86.3 percent, 4.0 hours; Bottling, 96000 bottles, 83.1 percent, 6.5 hours. Under "Needs attention": the canning line's seamer is worn and is behind most of the downtime; the part arrives on 2026-11-03 and will be fitted on 2026-11-04, and the 3 held batches must be released or dumped by 2026-11-02. Under "Coming up": the winter ale brew on 2026-11-09 and the packaging audit on 2026-11-12.

edit.request: The seamer part now arrives on 2026-10-31 and will be fitted on 2026-11-01. Also correct the canning efficiency to 74.0 percent.
